title: 3D 导航的艺术风格过于极端，导致眼睛疲劳和头痛。
description: 3D 导航的艺术风格过于极端，导致眼睛疲劳和头痛。
evidence: I'm happy about the 3d navigation but it is way too extreme with the artwork to make it enjoyable. After an hour and a half I have a headache from the eye strain.
